why: Opened by hand on the operator's go-ahead: one long session from rs/HANDOFF.md to a client and server that interoperate with the C++ xs.

agent.summary: Added the xs-rs binary crate with a Linux client and server that speak the C++ xs version 4 stream in both directions. A C++ client can push to and pull from xs-rs, and xs-rs can push to and pull from a C++ xs server; trees compare equal including modes, nanosecond mtimes, symlinks, empty entries and non-UTF-8 names, with compressed and no-op transfers verified.
agent.diagnosis: The previous worktree had only the wire codec. The cost was in the transfer engine: listing, NEED generation, DATA records, XXH3 checksums, zstd bodies and destination publication all had to be written and matched to remote.cpp. Measurements on real-projects through fakessh: C++ xs fresh 28.3 s and 44.6 s, xs-rs fresh 23.3 s and 36.1 s; C++ no-op 10.5 s and 11.2 s, xs-rs no-op 5.0 s and 5.1 s. The C++ runs also reported exit 23 on an unreadable source subdirectory.
agent.change: New rs/xs-rs crate (client, --server, CLI, scanner, codec, transfer engine) in the rs workspace; system libxxhash/libzstd linked from build.rs; integration tests under rs/xs-rs/tests; README and workspace manifest updated. A root workspace package was added solely so the required `cargo fmt --manifest-path rs/Cargo.toml --check` has a target in this cargo version.
agent.expected_effect: C++ xs interoperates byte-for-byte with xs-rs for MVP tree copies, including -z and single-file destinations. No-op transfers avoid DATA frames by comparing size and whole-second mtime, and the sender uses a queued writer thread so a full NEED pipe cannot deadlock the walk.
agent.risks: The receiver is single-threaded and still walks destination paths with std path calls; very large or deeply nested trees may not reach the optimistic syscall counts of the C++ engine, though no-op measured faster here. Owner/group, xattrs, ACLs, hard links, delta, resume, deletion and filters remain for later steps. Source scan failures are currently skipped rather than propagated as exit 23.
agent.tests: XS_BIN=~/benchmarks/lab/engineer/XR10200022-mvp/parent/build/xs cargo test --manifest-path rs/Cargo.toml: all pass (9 xs-rs interop tests, 13 xs-wire unit tests, 4 xs-wire interop tests). cargo clippy --manifest-path rs/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings: pass. cargo fmt --manifest-path rs/Cargo.toml --check: pass. Interop tests cover all four transfer directions, no-op, changed files, -z, single-file destinations, version refusal and a hostile path name.
